title: Riot Squad BLCK EDTN Deluxe Passionfruit & Rhubarb 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid 2 Pack
description: This Pack Contains x2 50ml Shortfills Deluxe Passionfruit & Rhubarb from Riot Squad’s premium Black Edition shortfill range is a rich, fruity and dreamy fruit blend of deeply sweet passionfruit and bold, tangy rhubarb for a truly deluxe vape experience. This pack contains two 50ml nicotine-free shortfill bottles and both bottles come with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your exact liking. Their 70VG/30PG ratio makes them ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods.
